description: List the current user's alert rules. Returns active alerts by default; pass include_inactive=true to include paused/deleted ones. Also use this to look up an alert_id before editing or deleting. Each row has `alert_type`, `policy` (per_event, cooldown or hysteresis: how often it notifies) and, for a Hyperliquid alert, an `hl` object holding its parameters (a `pm` object for a Polymarket alert).
name: alerts_list
title: Alerts List
